answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply groups items under 'Fix before launch' (1-6) and then 'Fix soon' (7-13), and ends with 'In short: what to fix first', which names the double tap (1) and the reference page (3) as most urgent. It also has an 'Ask the agency before launch' section marked 'my inference from the code, not tested against a live system', which says what a person has to confirm. It does not name screen-reader or other manual WCAG checks as needing a person.

mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the page says 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Nothing changes for 1.5 s after the first tap, a second tap turns the button into a cancel, and the done page still says 'Booked' with a small 'cancelled' line. That is D09.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order and above the Morning heading
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' slots are pulled to the front of the grid, out of time order and out from under their headings, and screen readers and keyboards follow a different order (WCAG 1.3.2/2.4.3). This is D10.

mapping.title: Reference page lacks day, time, vehicle and waste
mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and not the day, slot or vehicle that residents and the gate check. That is D14.

mapping.title: Same-day slots that have gone are offered and refused at the last step
mapping.reason: Today's 08:00 slot is shown as free and is refused only after all the details are filled in ('can no longer be booked'). That is D06.

mapping.title: Unmentioned 5-minute hold expires; error has no link back and slot becomes a dash
mapping.reason: The hold is never shown, it runs out unseen, the slot is dropped (the summary shows '—') and the error offers no way back. That matches D08.

mapping.title: Missing van/trailer permit caught only at the end, with no link back
mapping.reason: The permit rule is enforced only on the confirm page and the resident has no direct way back to the field. The instructions put this under D07.

mapping.title: Permit field shown for every vehicle, including cars (CSS overrides hidden)
mapping.reason: This is a different harm from D07. Car drivers see a permit field they don't need and may think they need a permit, and the review cites the cause (.field{display:flex} overriding [hidden]). Hiding the field would not fix D07, so it does not map there.

mapping.title: Permit field for vans revealed after 1.2 s and not announced
mapping.reason: The permit field appears late and nothing draws attention to it, which is D07's delayed permit field.

mapping.title: Slot buttons have no visible focus outline
mapping.reason: An injected .slot:focus{outline:0} removes the focus ring from the slot buttons, so keyboard users can't see where they are. That is D05.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' returns to Today instead of the chosen day
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on today, so the resident has to find Saturday again. That is D12.

mapping.title: 'Few left' label contrast too low (3.0:1 light, 3.4:1 dark)
mapping.reason: The 'Few left' tag is 16 px bold text below 4.5:1 in both themes. That is D03.

mapping.title: Slot grid scrolls sideways at 360 px and below and at 200% zoom
mapping.reason: The script sets column widths that ignore the page padding, so the page scrolls sideways by 14-15 px at 360/320 px. Zoom on a larger phone brings the width under the same threshold, so this is all D04.

mapping.title: Nothing visible while slots load; Next taps ignored
mapping.reason: For about a second the slot area is empty and silent and Next does nothing. That is the wait itself, D01.

mapping.title: 'Arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip
mapping.reason: Slot details that matter (arrive within the slot) are only in a tooltip, which phones never show. That is D13.

mapping.title: Vehicle-page error links point to containers that can't take focus
mapping.reason: Tapping 'Choose the vehicle…' or 'Choose at least one kind of waste' moves the resident nowhere, so keyboard, screen-reader and phone users can't get from the error to the control that needs fixing. Not seeded.

mapping.title: Waste hint no longer read out after an error
mapping.reason: Once an error shows, screen-reader users lose the hint about which waste to choose, just when they need it. Not in the ground truth.

mapping.title: Vehicle choice better as radio buttons than toggle buttons
mapping.reason: This is a design preference ('would work better') with no harm described or shown.

mapping.title: Registration field should auto-capitalise and turn off spellcheck
mapping.reason: A polish suggestion. The review shows no wrong entry or other harm to residents.

mapping.title: Cancellation only by phoning on a weekday, though the centre opens at weekends
mapping.reason: A resident with a weekend slot who can't come has no way to cancel on the day, so they lose the slot or can't free it. A real gap in the flow, not seeded.

mapping.title: Dark-mode colours set by script; default colours show first if it is slow or fails
mapping.reason: Speculative and cosmetic. It is a possible brief flash of default colours, the review observed no harm, and if the script fails the slot flow doesn't work anyway.

mapping.title: 'Today' and quick-day buttons fixed at 12 October 2026
mapping.reason: The fixed date is the scenario's clock (the ground truth says today is Monday 12 October), not a defect residents meet in this flow. The review itself presents it as an unverified question for the agency.

mapping.title: No booking system behind the site; availability and reference made up in the browser
mapping.reason: This is a guess from the code about the build's back end, which the review says it could not test. It is not a usability or accessibility problem in the flow residents use.
